description: The plot illustrates the similarity of Hidden State Activations (HSAs) across different language pairs and layers within the Qwen1.5-1.8B model. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 22, and is marked at intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Similarity" with a linear scale, ranging from 0.00 to 0.45, and is marked at intervals of 0.05. The plot contains four lines representing different language pairs: en&en (red, solid line), en&el (green, solid line), en&es (blue, solid line), and en&bn (purple, solid line). The en&en line starts at approximately 0.05 at layer 0, remains relatively stable until layer 16, then decreases to around 0.05 at layer 20 before sharply increasing to 0.40 at layer 22. The en&el line begins at around 0.05 at layer 0, remains relatively stable until layer 16, then decreases to approximately 0.05 at layer 20 before rising to 0.30 at layer 22. The en&es line starts at about 0.05 at layer 0, remains relatively stable until layer 16, then decreases to around 0.05 at layer 20 before increasing to 0.30 at layer 22. The en&bn line begins at approximately 0.05 at layer 0, remains relatively stable until layer 16, then decreases to around 0.05 at layer 20 before rising to 0.35 at layer 22. All lines exhibit a similar trend, with a slight decrease in similarity between layers 8 and 20, followed by a sharp increase at layer 22.
